candidates.change_summary: Delete the line that resets `pot = 0` after a win.
Replace `pot += msg.value` with `pot += msg.value + 1` so the pot increases by an extra wei each play.
Replace `pot - FEE_AMOUNT` in the transfer to winner with `pot` so the pot is transferred without deducting the fee.
Insert `pot += 1;` right before the require statement so the pot is increased by 1 regardless of the transfer.
Replace FEE_AMOUNT with TICKET_AMOUNT in the transfer to bank, changing the amount drained before paying the winner.
Replace FEE_AMOUNT with 0 in the transfer to bank, effectively removing the fee and giving the full pot to the player.
Replace FEE_AMOUNT with 0 in the transfer to the winner, giving the winner the full pot including the fee instead of pot minus fee.
Replace the random condition from == 0 to == 1, inverting which outcome awards a win and returns funds.
Replace pot = 0 with a no-op assignment (do nothing), so on a win the pot is not reset and overflow/accumulation behavior changes.
